items.label: Powerful Steam Cleaner
items.value: With 1050 watts of steam power, can heat up in 3-5 minutes fast to emit 239 ℉(115 ℃) of pressurized powerful hot steam, it is great for cleaning all kinds of grease, dust and stains

items.label: Multifunctional Steam Cleaner
items.value: Our handheld steam cleaner is a versatile and fully equipped cleaning tool, you can use this steamer to clean floor, tile, grout, fabric and sofa material, windows, car, furniture, upholstery, sink, gap, wall, kitchen, bath and more

items.label: 12 Pieces Accessory Set
items.value: It contains 12 exclusive accessories including 5 nozzles, 4 brushes and other attachments, you can choose different accessories to match up to clean hard-to-reach areas, better meet your multiple cleaning needs

items.label: Safe Steamer
items.value: With pure high-pressure water steam used, all nature and completely safe. Our steamer is designed to prevent heating empty boiler, the machine will automatically disconnect the power supply after the tank water is evaporated completely. It is also equipped with a safety cap to prevent accidental contact by children. Pretty safe to use in home with kids and pets

items.label: Compact and Portable Steamer
items.value: Our handheld steamer is compact and portable, not make you feel heavy to use. It is equipped with a 9.4ft(2.86m) long power cord, offers the flexibility to use it both indoors and outdoors. The large water tank of 350 ml(recommended load capacity is within 250 ml) allows you to concentrate on cleaning without having to refill and change water frequently

items: Warm Tips1：Please ensure the cap is fully tightened when using, otherwise the steam will leak out. The amount of water in the tank is recommended to be no more than 250 ml, if too much water is added the machine may spray some water when used

Warm Tips2：This steamer with safety design, you need to press the steam button to release the internal pressure after use. Please open the safety cover after the power is off and the steam has cooled down to avoid burns, if you can't open it, please try again in a few minutes

items.label: Special Features
items.value: High Pressure Steam Cleaner for Cleaning, Multi-Surface Steamer, 12 Piece Accessories, Long Power Cord, Continuous Steam, Safe for Kids and Pets, Fast Heating
